actions.doc: Speak text aloud using the configured speech capability. Playback can be partially audible before an error. No silent fallback.

parameters.name: emotion
parameters.description: The facial expression to display in the voice circle.
parameters.constraints: Exactly one of: smile, happy, laugh, thinking, surprised, sad, love. Case-sensitive; no default.

actions.doc: Show a large facial expression in the center of the voice circle. Use sparingly when it suits the reply. Replaces the previous expression, without adding to captions or speech. Visible until replaced, the user speaks again, or the session stops. This controls UI only.
